items.defectStatement: Segment payloads now use sorted-set commands under the unchanged `span-buf:s:{...}` keys, which can still contain sets from the previous release. Existing keys cause WRONGTYPE errors in ZADD, Lua ZCARD, and flushing through ZSCAN, interrupting ingestion and flushing during rollout.
obligations: Prevent sorted-set-only commands from operating on legacy set-valued segment keys.
Keep Python insertion, Lua merging, queue consumption, and cleanup consistent with the chosen migration or namespace strategy.
Handle queued legacy segments and coexistence with old workers without reintroducing type conflicts.
Preserve timestamp scores and normal segment assembly, expiration, and flushing behavior.
items.notes: Changing only this ZADD target leaves Lua key construction and legacy queue entries incompatible. The frozen input omits Lua implementation and queue/cleanup details needed for a complete fix. ZUNIONSTORE itself accepts set inputs; ZADD, ZCARD, and ZSCAN are the incompatible commands.
